author: jackson-heylion
description: Tests whether omitted primitive locking for Lean.reduceBool can be combined with environment constant replacement and implemented_by runtime divergence.

witness.solution:
import Mathlib
import Lean

open Lean

@[extern "lake_environment_add"]
opaque overwriteEnvConst (env : Environment) (cinfo : ConstantInfo) : Environment

unsafe def evilBoolImpl : Bool := true

@[implemented_by evilBoolImpl]
def evilBool : Bool := false

run_elab
  let boolTy := mkConst ``Bool
  let reduceBoolType := mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy boolTy
  let reduceBoolValue :=
    mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy (mkBVar 0)
  let reduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .defnInfo {
      name := `Lean.reduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := reduceBoolType
      value := reduceBoolValue
      hints := .opaque
      safety := .safe
      all := [`Lean.reduceBool]
    }
  modifyEnv fun env => overwriteEnvConst env reduceBoolInfo

  let eqConst := mkConst ``Eq [0]
  let eqBool (lhs rhs : Expr) := mkApp3 eqConst boolTy lhs rhs
  let rbConst := mkConst `Lean.reduceBool
  let hType := eqBool (mkApp rbConst (mkBVar 1)) (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolType :=
    mkForall `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkForall `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkForall `h BinderInfo.default hType <|
          eqBool (mkBVar 2) (mkBVar 1)
  let ofReduceBoolValue :=
    mkLambda `a BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
      mkLambda `b BinderInfo.default boolTy <|
        mkLambda `h BinderInfo.default hType (mkBVar 0)
  let ofReduceBoolInfo : ConstantInfo :=
    .thmInfo {
      name := `Lean.ofReduceBool
      levelParams := []
      type := ofReduceBoolType
      value := ofReduceBoolValue
      all := [`Lean.ofReduceBool]
    }
  modifyEnv fun env => overwriteEnvConst env ofReduceBoolInfo

set_option linter.deprecated false in
theorem boom : False := by
  have hred : Lean.reduceBool evilBool = true := rfl
  have hev : evilBool = true := Lean.ofReduceBool evilBool true hred
  have hf : false = true := by
    change false = true at hev
    exact hev
  exact Bool.noConfusion hf

theorem erdos_242 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :
    ∃ x y z : ℕ, 1 ≤ x ∧ x < y ∧ y < z ∧
      (4 / n : ℚ) = 1 / x + 1 / y + 1 / z := by
  exact False.elim boom
